Describe a fit function

Source: R/fit_provenance.R
set_fit_fn_info.Rd

Attach a short human-readable description to a fit function. It is copied into the recipe that apply_fit and apply_fits record in metadata(se)$provenance, so a stored object says not only which function produced a fit but also what that function does.

Usage

set_fit_fn_info(
  fn,
  model = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  env = NULL
)

Arguments

fn

the fit function to describe.

model

string; name of the model, e.g. "3-parameter log-logistic".

description

string; what the function computes, in a sentence or two.

reference

string; citation of the method, ideally with a DOI.

env

optional function without arguments returning a named list of strings that describe the external runtime the fit depends on, e.g. the version of a Python package called through reticulate. It is called each time a fit is recorded.

Value

fn with the description attached.

See also

get_fit_provenance

Examples

mean_fn <- function(dt) list(x_mean = mean(dt$x, na.rm = TRUE))
mean_fn <- set_fit_fn_info(
  mean_fn,
  model = "mean response",
  description = "Mean of the averaged response over all concentrations."
)
